items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I would take it down firm on paper. And then when I would finish it, he'd always pay me.

ctx.x: I would take it down firm on paper. And then when I would finish it, he'd always pay me. He always had money. And how he did, I don't know.
I guess he used to gamble a lot sometimes, really, Sam. Nobody did.
I didn't see him. I never saw him gamble.
